entities.name: José Luis Tejada Sorzano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Tejada Sorzano was a Bolivian economist, lawyer, and politician who served as the 34th president of Bolivia from 1934 to 1936. A member of the Liberal Party, he served as the 23rd vice president from 1931 to 1934 and was minister of finance in 1919.
